title: Archive research: Nixon could slip his security

tellings.quote: >> So and and Nixon we had heard these stories like they said, oh he couldn't get away from his security. So I checked it and sure enough he got away from his security lots of times.

plain: Richard Nixon, during his presidency from 1969 to 1974, often got away from his security detail, including around his home in Key Biscayne, Florida. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron tells Michels that people had dismissed stories about Nixon by saying he could never escape his guards, so Cameron checked Nixon's records at the National Archives and found that he had slipped them many times. It matters because it would make stories of Nixon going off privately to see something possible.
